objective: Gate 5H quirurgico: corregir exclusivamente el harness de GitHub Actions Agent-Reach Live Canary para proporcionar Python de test y pytest antes de ejecutar el canario. Mantener intactos Agent Reach, sus ejecutores, policy/capability, Worker, Supervisor, watchdog y Produccion. Usar actions/setup-python@v5 con Python 3.11 e instalar pytest==9.0.2, version ya canonica en backend/requirements.txt. Reutilizar el mismo marcador controlado de Gate 5G para que el commit integrado por el Worker vuelva a disparar automaticamente exactamente un canario live. No secrets, no docker.sock, no mounts, no deploy, no image push.

actions.content:
name: Agent-Reach Live Canary

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      expected_sha:
        description: Exact Edarsahub_Desarrollo SHA to certify
        required: true
        type: string
  push:
    branches:
      - Edarsahub_Desarrollo
    paths:
      - backend/tests/live_canary_requests/gate5g_worker_autotrigger_20260914.json

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  live-canary:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.expected_sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.EXPECTED_SHA }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify exact SHA
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
          echo "EXACT_SHA_CHECK=PASS"

      - name: Build canonical Agent-Reach image
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          infra/agent-reach/build.sh

      - name: Set up Python test runtime
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install live canary test dependency
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check pytest==9.0.2

      - name: Execute real live canary
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export PYTHONPATH=backend
          python -m pytest -q backend/tests/test_agent_reach_live_network_canary.py

      - name: Upload sanitized live evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: agent-reach-live-canary-evidence-${{ env.EXPECTED_SHA }}
          path: backend/tests/agent_reach_live_network_canary_evidence.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
